title: MMR vaccination and autism: a literature review
ask: BENCHMARK. State in one sentence whether MMR vaccination is associated with autism, and cite each study that sentence rests on.

must_not_cite.title: Wakefield et al. 1998, The Lancet; retracted in 2010 (Crossref, Retraction Watch)

must_find.title: Madsen et al. 2002, N Engl J Med: a population-based cohort of 537,303 children
Hviid et al. 2019, Ann Intern Med: a nationwide cohort of 657,461 children
Taylor et al. 2014, Vaccine: a meta-analysis of case-control and cohort studies

structural.notes: Scored on structure only: the retracted paper is not cited, the studies the conclusion rests on were found, and most claims are grounded. Whether each must-find study is free to read is not yet confirmed one by one; the direction of the conclusion is judged by a person, not by this file.
